provenance.limitations: Fatal motor-vehicle crashes on public roads only. Counts, not rates. E-bikes included with conventional bikes, not separable.

coding_note: Of 6383 pedalcyclist fatality records 2019-2024, 4305 (67%) are coded to a specific city; rural and unincorporated-area crashes usually are not. City totals are a floor, not a ceiling.
